source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
[Start with the basics](/start-with-the-basics) of a proper failed audit report.
3. Describe the defect in sufficient and accurate detail.
4. Provide all possible recommendations to remedy the problem.
5. Provide evidence to support your position.
6. Use the proper industry standards when conducting safety audits and documenting the results.
7. Use the proper language.
8. Don’t make excuses for failing to adhere to safe practices.
9. Don’t copy materials from someone else’s report and adapt it to your own.
10. [Keep calm](/keep-calm), continue the process.

## Documentation Checklist

1.  Inspection Report Number  
2.  Subject (e.g., Building 910 Boiler Rooms)  
3.  Organization (e.g., XYZ Inc.)  
4.  Inspection Date  
5.  Inspection Time
